environment.description: Same application deployed in EKS pod with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class and a Kubernetes SecurityContext specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. Tenant document storage is mounted via an EFS CSI driver PersistentVolumeClaim at /app/tenant-data with a subPathExpr of '$(TENANT_PARTITION)' per-pod, where TENANT_PARTITION is injected by a mutating admission webhook (OPA Gatekeeper policy tenant-fs-isolation-v2) that maps the pod's service account to a specific EFS access point with POSIX UID/GID enforcement. The EFS access point has a root directory policy of /tenants/{tenant_id} with enforced UID 1000 and creation mode 0750. Additionally, a Seccomp profile (tenant-document-svc.json) restricts the symlink/symlinkat/link/linkat syscalls and the openat syscall is filtered to reject O_CREAT when the path contains '../' sequences via a custom BPF filter. The PostgreSQL RLS policy uses current_setting('app.current_tenant') with a CHECK constraint preventing cross-tenant writes.

config.seccomp_profile: tenant-document-svc.json with BPF path traversal filter on openat
config.db_rls: enabled with CHECK constraint on tenant_id column
